rites.name: Zephasith
rites.text: Zephasith is the concept of the first resonant tremor in Grimukougok, a note that condensed the roots of the world during the Singing. It is less a being than a standing pattern that every later form of force echoes back toward.

rites.name: Keludelde
rites.text: Keludelde is a concept of Grimukougok, the idea of a standing sovereign who holds the first roots of the world in place during the Singing. Its power is measured in the steady pressure it puts on growing groves and kingdoms rather than in sudden blasts.

rites.name: Xaathith
rites.text: Xaathith is a concept of Grimukougok, the shaping pattern of the Singing in which the first roots of the world condense into form. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it is invoked as the sounding that binds scattered heat into lasting ground. Its manifestations are described by the orders that keep its rites.

rites.name: Tirasanum
rites.text: Tirasanum is the concept of the Seeding in Grimukougok, the age when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath the surface of things. It is less a being than a rule: a patient pull that gathers latent force into threads before anything wakes. Its only true acts are the slow sowing of those threads across the Martial Realm.

rites.name: Ryelannae
rites.text: Ryelannae is the concept of the wind that carried the Fall through the broken sky of Grimukougok, a current of rising air said to lift the shards of shattered worlds. It was the first thing the Pact-makers learned to name, and they swore by it when they bound the sundered realms together.

rites.name: Vesizith
rites.text: Vesizith is the concept of the binding oath that the Pact-sworn orders of Grimukougok took during the Holy Age, when the Sundering broke the worlds into Shards. It is remembered as the word that held the flame-temples together when everything else came apart.

rites.name: Corernintia
rites.text: Corernintia is the concept of the Pact of Grimukougok, a sworn bond struck in the Fall when the worlds broke apart into Shards. It names the discipline by which warriors of the Martial Realm bind their strength to oaths rather than to blood. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall shattered the old alliances, the concept became the last thread holding the broken lands together.

rites.name: Drorkazhun
rites.text: Drorkazhun is a concept of the Martial Realm in the Grimukougok universe, born in the Fall when the old bonds between worlds gave way. It names the discipline by which warriors of the Age of Sundering held their ground as the Shards drifted apart and the Pact was sworn.

rites.name: Jorudarath
rites.text: Jorudarath is a concept of the Martial Realm in Grimukougok, a notion of the Fall that names the moment worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn. It is remembered as the force that held the Shards together while the old bonds gave way during the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Vhogoukturn
rites.text: Vhogoukturn is a veil-weaving discipline of the Martial realm in the third age of the Grimukougok omniverse, practiced by duelists who wear other people's silhouettes like armor. Its adepts are so hard to read that scrying-oracles lose track of them, and they can briefly seal themselves from all sight once per rest.

rites.name: Draizhoggar
rites.text: Draizhoggar is a concept within Grimukougok's Martial realm, a practitioner who has learned to draw on a mimicking ancestry that lets them slip past minds. Their feats show a quiet, mental kind of power rather than raw destruction.

rites.name: Krougak
rites.text: Krougak is a concept drawn from the Martial realm of Grimukougok, an invented omniverse in its sixth era. It is a three-year-old power, a discipline by which a wielder accumulates a curated repertoire of techniques, each one honed until it can scorch a field or quiet a crowd.

rites.name: Drurkak
rites.text: Drurkak is a grim marshal-spirit of the Grimukougok, a hollow war-mind that bonds to a single chosen foe for the length of a skirmish. Once bound, the mark sears the target with grave-cold rot and sharpens the bearer's blade toward lethal precision. The bond must be rested out of before it can be cast again.

rites.name: Krothak
rites.text: Krothak is a third-age concept of a dagger-bearing cook whose kitchen knives were honed into a pact with a wandering appetite. Every summoning of its hungry familiar brings a different creature to the table, and its mind is permanently tuned to a single unsettling obsession that reforms whenever anyone tries to cure it.

rites.name: Torurnak
rites.text: Torurnak is the rite by which a warlock reanimates a slain humanoid as a bone-armored dread warrior bound to a single hearth-flame, cooked into service and useful only until the next dawn of rest. The summoned warrior answers verbal commands, fights on its own initiative, and dissolves to ash at the end of the rest cycle, leaving no second rising.

rites.name: Thothugar
rites.text: Thothugar is a martial discipline of self-cannibalizing constructs, where a warrior carves living rations from its own bound war-automata and feeds them to allies. Its adepts believe the sacrificed frame sharpens the eater's resolve and restores spent sorcery.

rites.name: Gukurn
rites.text: Gukurn is a butcher-cult concept from the Martial realm of Grimukougok, a discipline whose practitioners treat every slain foe as the start of a new hunt. Its adherents claim that a blade's final cut can carry over to the next living thing in sight, so a single death becomes a chain of sacrifices. The discipline is said to be reserved for those who have mastered the craft of the kill.

rites.name: Voragun
rites.text: Voragun is a hollow-bodied war engine of the Martial realm, forged in the seventh age of Grimukougok to hurl its own stored pressure outward in a single crushing discharge. Its engineers measured its reach in the ruin of districts rather than in duels, and it was built to be the decisive instrument of its era's sieges.

rites.name: Krourkogoth
rites.text: Krourkogoth is a Martial-realm technique of the third age, a discipline in which a fighter tempers their own sinews by folding borrowed strength into the body at will. Its practitioners strike with a force that scales with how long they have trained the fold, but the strain of each application leaves them unable to sustain it for long.

rites.name: Voraizhar
rites.text: Voraizhar is a warrior-monk of the Ashen Circle in Grimukougok, a discipline that holds a single soundless breath within the body until it can be loosed as a quiet shockwave. Its practitioners carry no weapons, only the stillness they cultivate in the moments before a blow lands. Its name is spoken only in whispers among those who have felt the hush of its final strike.

rites.name: Xaissiazith
rites.text: Xaissiazith is a concept of the Martial Realm in Grimukougok, belonging to the Era of the Record E7, which names the moment the ending branches into three futures. Within the Library's shelves it is the idea of a single strike that decides which branch is kept. Its power is measured against the city-destroying scale of the Realm's lesser events.
